evidence: Touches TxOrphanage in net_processing to prevent dropped orphan reconsiderations when peers disconnect, and adds a P2P liveness fuzz harness.
rationale: Fixes an exploitable relay liveness hole where orphans stuck awaiting reconsideration are abandoned if an announcer disconnects. As commit e974d21b4e notes, this allows an announcer to deliberately keep CPFP child transactions out of the mempool until the orphan expires.
